savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: Sec. 5. The Director of OPM shall provide for an orderly transition, including with respect to nominations, selection processes, and appointments, from the Presidential Management Intern Program established by Executive Order 12364 of May 24, 1982, to the Presidential Management Fellows Program established by this order. Until that transition is provided for, individuals who were selected or appointed under the provisions of Executive Order 12364 and who have not completed their scheduled periods of excepted service are hereby redesignated as Presidential Management Fellows, and continue their internships under the terms of Executive Order 12364.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Individuals selected or appointed under EO 12364 who have not completed their scheduled periods of excepted service are redesignated Presidential Management Fellows and 'continue their internships under the terms of Executive Order 12364' until OPM provides for the transition. The end of this continuation depends on an OPM act (and on each individual's scheduled period) that the order does not date.

exceptions.quote: Sec. 7. Executive Order 12364 is superseded, except as provided in section 5 of this order.
exceptions.applies_to: EO 12364: the supersession is expressly subject to sec. 5, so the terms of EO 12364 keep applying to the redesignated interns until OPM's transition is provided for.

effective_date_reading: Sec. 7 has no effective-date wording of its own and the order has no general effective-date clause, so the supersession would take effect on signing, 2003-11-21, except for the sec. 5 continuation, which has no determinable end in the held texts.

targets_in_batch_08.EO:12364: sec. 7 ('Executive Order 12364 is superseded, except as provided in section 5 of this order'); sec. 5 keeps the terms of EO 12364 for interns already selected until OPM provides for the transition: partial supersession; the whole order is NOT shown to end on 2003-11-21.

conclusion: EO 13318 (signed 2003-11-21, 68 FR 66317-66318, read once in full) constitutes the Presidential Management Fellows Program (secs. 1-4), directs OPM to provide an orderly transition from the Presidential Management Intern Program of EO 12364 (sec. 5), has OPM regulate (sec. 6), supersedes EO 12364 'except as provided in section 5' (sec. 7) and disclaims rights (sec. 8). Sec. 5 redesignates sitting interns as fellows who 'continue their internships under the terms of Executive Order 12364' until OPM provides for the transition. The supersession of EO 12364 is therefore partial on its face, and its residual part ends only on an undated OPM act and on individual service periods; the whole-order end of EO 12364 cannot be fixed from the held texts. EO 12364 is blocked in this batch for that reason.
